## Pros

- Aria V2 attaches directly, no adapter ([Aria V2 manual](https://back.prod.uppababy.com/media/4b/51/e9/1794583326/US-EN_1002-ARI_AriaV2Manual_260724.pdf)).
- Canopy called "the best canopy I've ever used on a stroller" ([CR](https://www.consumerreports.org/babies-kids/strollers/uppababy-vista-v3-stroller-review-a3015851098/)); [CR](https://www.consumerreports.org/babies-kids/strollers/uppababy-vista-v3/m415751/) maneuverability 5/5; 30 lb basket.

## Cons

- Toddler seat is from 3 months only; from birth it needs the Infant SnugSeat ($69.99) or Bassinet V3 ($279.99), neither included ([US manual 251118](https://back.prod.uppababy.com/media/59/08/8f/1764947843/NACN_0303-VSO_VistaV3Manual_251118_a11y.pdf)).
- Heaviest and widest folded of the strollers that pass 0003 alone, apart from Ridge V2; does not fit the overhead bin ([specs note](../../research/notes/2026-11-28-uppababy-strollers-specs-and-gates.md)).
- Fold needs two hands and several set-up steps ([BabyGearLab](https://www.babygearlab.com/reviews/getting-around/full-size-stroller/uppababy-vista-v3), [CR](https://www.consumerreports.org/babies-kids/strollers/uppababy-vista-v3/m415751/), [help centre](../../research/notes/2026-11-28-uppababy-full-size-usability.md)); pinches fingers when lifted folded ([BabyGearLab](https://www.babygearlab.com/reviews/getting-around/full-size-stroller/uppababy-vista-v3)).
- Reviews conflict on rough ground; [CR's tester](https://www.consumerreports.org/babies-kids/strollers/uppababy-vista-v3-stroller-review-a3015851098/) found it "rattly, almost rickety" on cobblestones.
- No hands-on test of the SnugSeat, or of an Aria or Mesa on it ([usability note](../../research/notes/2026-11-28-uppababy-full-size-usability.md)).
- Highest price of the line, $999.99 ([specs note](../../research/notes/2026-11-28-uppababy-strollers-specs-and-gates.md)).
